data.name: HelpStep1Desc
data.value: Click 'Import DWG' to select one or more DWG files. The program will automatically extract text entities.

data.name: HelpStep2Desc
data.value: Click 'Translate' to batch-translate with AI. Use the ⇄ button to toggle direction (Chinese→English / English→Chinese). 5-way concurrency, ~5x faster than serial.

data.name: HelpStep3Desc
data.value: Double-click the Translation column to edit directly. You can also 'Export Excel' to review in Excel, then 'Import Excel' to re-import.

data.name: HelpStep4Desc
data.value: Click 'Export DWG', select writeback mode (see below), to generate the translated drawing file. The program automatically optimizes text width and height to avoid overflow and collision.

data.name: HelpAutoCadModeDesc
data.value: Performs precise text replacement within the AutoCAD process, supporting frame detection, collision avoidance, smart width adjustment, and auto-scaling layout.

data.name: HelpAutoCadImportant
data.value: ⚠ Important: AutoCAD must be running first!

data.name: HelpAutoCadComNote
data.value: The program controls the running AutoCAD process via COM.

data.name: HelpOfflineModeDesc
data.value: No AutoCAD required. Uses ACadSharp library to modify DWG files directly. Includes smart width and height scaling, but no collision detection. Suitable for computers without AutoCAD installed.

data.name: HelpLayoutIntro
data.value: DWG Translator v2.1 includes comprehensive text layout optimization:

data.name: HelpLayoutFixedWidth
data.value: • Fixed-width MText: auto-adjusts rectangle width after translation to prevent excessive word spacing

data.name: HelpLayoutFreeWidth
data.value: • Free-width MText: conservative width setting for compact layout

data.name: HelpLayoutCollision
data.value: • Collision detection: auto-detects overlap between translated text and lines/graphics, reduces font height to avoid collision

data.name: HelpLayoutFrame
data.value: • Frame constraint: automatically finds optimal font height within drawing frame to prevent overflow

data.name: HelpLicenseIntro
data.value: DWG Translator offers three license plans:

data.name: HelpLicensePerpetualDesc
data.value: One-time payment, permanent use of current major version

data.name: HelpFaq1Q
data.value: Q: What if text spacing is too large after translation?

data.name: HelpFaq1A
data.value: A: v2.1 has optimized fixed-width MText processing and will auto-shrink overly wide rectangle widths. If issues persist, manually adjust MText definition width in AutoCAD.

data.name: HelpFaq2Q
data.value: Q: What if translated text overlaps with lines?

data.name: HelpFaq2A
data.value: A: In AutoCAD precise writeback mode, the program auto-detects collisions and reduces font height. Offline mode does not support collision detection — use AutoCAD mode.

data.name: HelpFaq3Q
data.value: Q: Export DWG shows 'DwgTranslator.Cad.dll not found'?

data.name: HelpFaq3A
data.value: A: In Settings → AutoCAD Configuration → Plugin Path, specify the full path to DwgTranslator.Cad.dll.

data.name: HelpFaq4Q
data.value: Q: AutoCAD shows 'Load assemblies from untrusted path'?

data.name: HelpFaq4A
data.value: A: This is AutoCAD's security prompt when loading .NET plugins for the first time. Follow these steps:

data.name: HelpFaq4Step1
data.value: 1. This dialog may be behind the AutoCAD window! Click the AutoCAD icon in the taskbar to switch to AutoCAD

data.name: HelpFaq4Step2
data.value: 2. In the security dialog, click 'Always Load'

data.name: HelpFaq4Step3
data.value: 3. If you only click 'Load', this dialog will appear again next time

data.name: HelpFaq4Tip
data.value: Tip: DWG Translator will remind you about this dialog before sending commands

data.name: HelpFaq5Q
data.value: Q: How to cancel DWG export?

data.name: HelpFaq5A
data.value: A: During export, a red 'Cancel Export' button appears in the toolbar — click it to cancel. If AutoCAD is processing a command, cancellation may need to wait for the current operation to complete.
